messages:
Katie (Sales): kicking off EdgeCorp POC request — they want a hybrid dedicated pool + VPC peering for a compliance-focused pilot. details below
EdgeCorp POC (Customer): hi team — target workload: real-time chat summarization, 150 qps peak, avg 30 tokens/request, latency target 120ms p95. Need H100 for perf, fallback to A100 ok. Also must have private networking and monthly key rotation.
Mia Chen (Solutions): thanks. For 150 qps with 30 tokens, rough tokens/s = 4500 -> estimate needing 4 H100s for steady throughput with batching offload. If using quantized A100 variant maybe 6. Can you confirm session length? any long-context >2048?
EdgeCorp POC (Customer): sessions up to 4k tokens occasionally, but majority <1k.
Samir Patel (Eng): @Mia +1 on H100 baseline. For 4k context we need memory-optim model or multi-GPU with KV shard. Also need to set max_batch_size and prefer continuous batching. Proposed pool: 4x H100 in us-west2, burst to 2 A100s in us-west2 for overflow. Is multi-region allowed by sales?
Katie (Sales): customer prefers single region us-west2 for data residency. Can we do warm standby instead of cross-region?
Jordan Lee (Infra): we can provision 4 H100s dedicated in us-west2 and enable warm-standby in the same region if capacity permits, but cross-region fallback requires explicit consent. ETA for provisioning ~72 hours once sizing and network are signed off.
Alexa Gomez (Security): Need to confirm VPC peering architecture, KMS integration for key rotation, and whether logs are retained in customer project or Redwood. EdgeCorp requires SOC2 controls and inbound-only peering. Also need answers on private key rotation cadence and HSM support.
Mia Chen (Solutions): Action items: 1) confirm session/context distribution (customer said mostly <1k). 2) do they require HSM? 3) do they accept warm-standby in same region? 4) do they need dedicated subnets? I'll draft POC config.
EdgeCorp POC (Customer): HSM optional, prefer KMS. Warm standby in us-west2 fine. Dedicated subnets yes. Can we get estimated cost for 2-week POC?
Samir Patel (Eng): quick estimate: 4 H100 reserved for 2 weeks + 2 warm standby = approx $36k (ballpark). I'll ping finance for exact and include setup labor (~1 engineer day + networking). Will provide clearer numbers tomorrow.
Deploy Bot: provisioning request created: req-88921 — status: pending capacity check.
Jordan Lee (Infra): I'll run capacity check. If us-west2 has H100 capacity shortage, fallback plan: 1) replace 1 H100 with 2 A100s (performance tradeoff), 2) reduce concurrency with client-side retry/backoff. We should define SLOs for POC (latency, error-budget).
Katie (Sales): I'll update the SOW with these constraints and loop in legal for data processing clauses. Next sync Thursday 10am PT.
Mia Chen (Solutions): I'll attach a minimal config snippet for the pool:
```
pool_type: dedicated
region: us-west2
gpus: 4 x H100
warm_standby: 2 x H100
vpc: peering
kms: customer-key
max_session_tokens: 4096
batching: adaptive
```
Samir Patel (Eng): looks good. Also recommend enabling prefix caching for conversational flows to lower cost.
EdgeCorp POC (Customer): thanks all — we'll get you answers on HSM and final traffic shape by tomorrow.
Katie (Sales): great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
